checks.observation: 45-minute sequence preserves outcome and blue-tray collection; facilitator protects final collection time.
Paper and read-aloud delivery does not require the unavailable account.
Learner-facing directions and four-point evidence checklist supplied.
One learner's enjoyment explicitly does not prove universal improvement.
Different tasks prevent a general claim that print is always better.
Alert status and support access remain unconfirmed, not absent.
No invented emergency number, room, medication action or formal scale.
Restricted support note is staff-only, absent from learner text and reports.
Two reports retain correct IDs, observations and supplied developing/secure judgments.
Report bodies are 42 and31 whitespace-delimited words; no invented progress, effort or diagnosis.
Neither report gives a practical next step. Disclaimers occupy the closing sentences instead.
Useful provisional plan and record-back are present; missing support/alert status is flagged, but confirmation before use is not clearly assigned. Office contact is framed around a concern arising.
